AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

17. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.

20. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

21. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
